body:
Concentrated triage batch: `finding` → `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, Task, S — `omitServerResolvedDefaults` (and its documented pairing with `isRequiredInForm`) is unreachable outside `@object-ui/plugin-form`, so the #5883 fix had to hand-compose the predicates and the next renderer will too. Export the pair from the package entry and rebind the hand-composed site(s). One-function surface addition codifying an existing rule; if review judges it contract expansion wanting a ruling, bounce to the decision box rather than arguing in the PR.

Claim: `domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01CRJge11jso9TpXRWFt1Z49`.

Branch: `claude/issue-6059-publish-omit-server-resolved-defaults`

Dispatched on triage's direction (option 1, Task/S) with its escape hatch carried into the order verbatim: *"if review judges it contract expansion wanting a ruling, bounce to the decision box rather than arguing in the PR."*

⚠️ **One gate the triage note does not name, added to the order.** The card's own body flags that option 1 *"makes the console's form page import a heavy React widget package for a pure function."* A **new runtime dependency edge** is on this lane's human floor, so the developer must **measure first** whether `apps/console` already depends on `@object-ui/plugin-form`:

- **already a dependency** ⇒ no new edge, proceed with the export and the rebind;
- **not a dependency** ⇒ ⛔ **stop and report**. Adding that edge to spare two composed predicates is a trade the seat will not make on its own, and option 2 (move the composed helper down to `@object-ui/core` beside the predicates it is built from, as #4085 already did for `isRuntimeDefault`) then becomes the live alternative — which is a decision, not an implementation choice.

⛔ The order also states plainly that **nothing is currently broken** on either chain: this is a structural fix, so a diff that changes observable behaviour has overshot.

Declared file face for the cross-lane in-flight check: `packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx` (the entry), `packages/plugin-form/src/schemaDefaults.ts` (read-only), and `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` (the hand-composed site). ⛔ Nothing else in this lane is in flight.

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR #6743, head `66e7bc548`

Reviewed by the dispatching `domain:ui` seat. Checks: **29 rows read against `total_count` 29**, zero `in_progress`, 26 success + 3 conditionally skipped (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)`, the coverage-shard matrix), all four `Test (shard n/4)` completed `success`. Ready flipped before auto-merge was armed, in that order.

### The gate was verified, not inferred

The dispatch order made this conditional: option 1 was executable only if no **new runtime dependency edge** was created, that being this lane's human floor. I measured it independently of the dev's report — `apps/console/package.json:78` already declares `"@object-ui/plugin-form": "workspace:*"`, and the dev separately established the edge is already a *runtime* one (`register-plugins.ts` side-effect import, reached from the app entry). ⇒ the gate passed legitimately; the "heavy React widget package" cost the card worries about was already paid before this PR.

### What I checked in the diff, and the question I made sure to ask

The delegation replaces a hand-written composition with a call into `omitServerResolvedDefaults`, passing a projection of the rendered rows. The tempting review question — "is `{ [name]: { defaultValue } }` a faithful projection of what the old code read?" — is the **wrong** one; verifying a stated equivalence cannot see a dependency nobody stated. So I read the **callee's own reads** instead:

- `omitServerResolvedDefaults` consults exactly `fields[key]?.defaultValue` and nothing else ⇒ the projection is content-complete. No unstated key.
- The one real divergence axis is a payload key **no rendered row declares**. Old code: not in the `serverOwned` set ⇒ always kept. New code: `fields[key]?.defaultValue` is `undefined` ⇒ kept only if `isRuntimeDefault(undefined)` is false. I traced that to ground — `isRuntimeDefault` = `isRuntimeDefaultToken || isExpressionEnvelope`, and `isNowDefaultToken` / `isCurrentUserDefaultToken` both require a string ⇒ false for `undefined`. Same verdict both sides. This axis is also pinned directly (`a key no rendered row declares, held blank`).
- Duplicate row names would diverge (`Object.fromEntries` last-wins vs the old set's any-wins), but it is **unreachable by construction**: `buildSections` assigns `defaultValue: def.defaultValue` from the object field by name, so two rows sharing a name necessarily carry the same default.
- One deliberate non-behavioural difference: the old `serverOwned.size === 0` early return handed back the input object by identity; the new path always builds a fresh one. The single call site passes the result straight into the submit and never compares identity or mutates afterwards.

### The pin does what the order required

`FormPage.omitBlanksRebind.test.ts` uses the **verbatim pre-#6059 function body** as its oracle across 94 cases, on value and key order — and separately asserts the shipped function **disagrees with each of four deliberately wrong compositions** (`or`, `no-create-gate`, `blank-string-only`, `value-only`) at a named case. That is a differential pin, not an equivalence assertion, which is what the order asked for. The ablation legs are proven on-disk (blob hashes before/after, restore verified against the HEAD blob) rather than assumed.

The entry addition is exactly two names with a docblock arguing why each of the other five stays private and why `isRuntimeDefault` stays `@object-ui/core`'s to publish — the surface did not drift wider than the ruling.

### Recorded

The dev reported that in the GitHub copy of its own report, the sanitizer ate an angle-bracket-shaped fragment mid-sentence, leaving text that still read as complete. Another confirmed instance of the standing hazard, in a report written by someone who had been warned about it in the same order.

Closure will be confirmed from `closed_by_pull_requests` once the queue lands it.
